rationale: The plan correctly refuses to refit the count model, uses all 12000 tested genes in a pre-ranked gseapy.prerank run against a named, versioned local Hallmark GMT (h.all.v2026.1.Hs), states a deterministic tie rule, and reports NES and FDR with both 0.25 and 0.05 thresholds. It falls short of the reference on the GSEA settings: the ranking metric is hedged (product of log2FC and -log10 p 'or' the Wald stat, even though the stat column is listed as present), there is no rule for missing p-values, and the set size window (15-500), permutation count (>=1000), and fixed seed are never specified. The report omits the leading edge per set and package versions. The shallow sample_01 is acknowledged as an upstream caveat but sample QC and the DE-model criteria are only implicitly handled by deferring to the existing results rather than being stated.
